description: NaYbCl₄ is Hydrophilite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/c space group. Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with eight equivalent YbCl₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-53°. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.73-2.87 Å. Yb is bonded to six Cl atoms to form YbCl₆ octahedra that share corners with eight equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent YbCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-53°. There are a spread of Yb-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.68 Å. There are two inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Yb atoms. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two equivalent Na and one Yb atom.
